newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates close at 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates close at 20 percent.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates soared to close at 20 percent on Thursday compared to 3.0 percent on Wednesday and dealers said they were likely to stay firm till the weekend.
Unexpectedly overnight rates shot up to 20 percent due to a shortage of funds and the discounting of about three billion rupees was also reported, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Earlier deals were struck at between 13 and 15 percent, the dealer said.
